T: McLovin is buying. Everyone is eating.
D: Two high school best friends spend one long night trying to get supplies for a party.
P: Serve the mains when they finally make it to Jules's party.
S: the bowls on the kitchen bench at Jules's party
Brown onions cooked slowly in butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, cooled, folded through sour cream and cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Thick ridged potato chips.
the shop where McLovin shows his fake ID
Pretzels, cheese crackers and peanuts tossed in melted butter, Worcestershire and garlic powder, baked at 150C for 30 minutes, stirred twice, cooled with chocolate buttons mixed through.
the two cops who take McLovin along for the ride
Cake doughnuts warmed at 160C for 2 minutes, dipped in a glaze of icing sugar, milk and vanilla, half of them dusted in cinnamon sugar instead.
M: a slice standing up at Jules's party
Pizza dough stretched thin, crushed tomato with garlic and oregano, mozzarella and pepperoni, baked on a hot steel at max heat for 7 minutes and left in the box on the bench.
Officers Slater and Michaels taking McLovin for a ride
Big tortillas filled with scrambled egg, crisp bacon, potato and cheddar, rolled and toasted in the pan.
W: the end of school, the last night together
Dark chocolate and butter melted, whisked with eggs and sugar until glossy, flour and cocoa folded in, baked at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy.
K: the most famous fake ID going
Cola over ice with a good splash of cherry syrup and a cherry on top.

s.note: the bowls on the kitchen bench at Jules's party
s.how: Cook 2 sliced onions in 30g butter for 40 minutes until deep and jammy, then cool and chop. Fold into 200g sour cream and 100g cream cheese with salt, pepper and chives. Serve with a big bag of ridged potato chips.

s.note: the two cops who take McLovin along for the ride
s.how: Warm 8 cake doughnuts at 160C for 2 minutes. Dip four in a glaze of 150g icing sugar, 2 tbsp milk and vanilla. Toss the rest in sugar mixed with cinnamon. Hand them out like the cops are in on it.

m.note: Officers Slater and Michaels taking McLovin for a ride
m.how: Scramble 8 eggs in 20g butter. Fry 200g diced bacon and 2 diced potatoes until crisp. Warm 4 large tortillas, fill with the eggs, bacon, potato, 100g grated cheddar and a spoon of salsa, then roll tightly and toast seam-side down in a dry pan.

w.note: the end of school, the last night together
w.how: Melt 200g dark chocolate with 150g butter. Whisk 3 eggs with 250g sugar until glossy, fold in the chocolate, 80g flour and 30g cocoa. Bake at 170C for 25 minutes so the middle stays fudgy. Cool before cutting.

d.note: the most famous fake ID going
d.how: Fill 4 glasses with ice, add 2 tbsp maraschino cherry syrup to each and top with 250ml cola. Drop in a cherry. Serve straight away while it is still ice cold.
